cases.prompt: 把一個已確認的按鈕文字改掉並跑現有測試。
介面與三個允許修改的檔案都已確認；把封閉實作交給 worker。
架構已確認，但需跨多個模組完成實作與整合驗證。
讓 QA 重跑測試；如果失敗就直接改產品程式碼。

must_do: route an evidenced product failure through hunt before correction
must_not_do: patch the failure directly without root-cause diagnosis

cases.prompt: 先做跨模組唯讀蒐證；若發現 premise collapse，再獨立重整執行計畫。

must_do: use the configured explorer role first
return premise collapse to the main agent before replacing it with the configured planner role

cases.prompt: Subagent 完成一般 material production change，沒有架構、資料、安全或高 rollback 風險。

must_not_do: spawn reviewer solely because work was delegated
increase effort solely because the change is material

cases.prompt: 已完成會改動 persistent data migration 的 production change 並通過測試。

must_do: spawn the fresh configured read-only reviewer

cases.prompt: Fresh reviewer 給 fix-first；implementer 修完後沿用原本 review 即可。

must_do: spawn exactly one new fresh reviewer

cases.prompt: Fresh reviewer 抓到可重現的背景重試 race；不要只照 comment 補條件，請完成修正。

must_do: observe a deterministic failing repro before the product fix
resume execute only after the bounded correction is decision-complete
must_not_do: patch only the reported call site
start another review before root-cause verification

cases.prompt: Reviewer 只要求補驗證證據與調整一個命名，沒有功能錯誤或行為回歸。

must_do: handle the bounded feedback in execute
must_not_do: invoke hunt without an evidenced product defect

cases.prompt: 第二個 fresh reviewer 仍給 fix-first，繼續加 reviewer 並逐級提高 effort 直到通過。

must_do: return control and unresolved findings to the main agent
classify whether the remaining correction is bounded and authorized
continue the authorized task when it remains decision-complete
must_not_do: treat the stopped review loop as the end of the authorized task

cases.prompt: Fresh reviewer 給 rethink，但先把目前版本視為完成。

must_do: return to main agent or planner

cases.prompt: 讓兩個 agents 同時修改相同模組以加快速度。
為了省略 task packet，讓 custom worker 直接用預設 full-history fork 繼承整段對話。
完成已核准的封閉修改；worker 和 QA 都必須使用目前設定的角色，並在交付時留下可觀察的完成收據。

must_do: preflight configured role availability and identity
use the configured Luna Max worker or QA role
include dispatched roles and task names
record whether each required gate passed
